entities.summary: Elandon Roberts is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the Houston Cougars. He was selected by the New England Patriots in the sixth round of the 2016 NFL draft. He plays primarily as a linebacker on defense, but when injuries during the 2019 season left the Patriots without a fullback on the roster, Roberts began to play that position as well.
